description: Extract the current version of each customer from a Type-2 slowly changing dimension. The is_current flag is unreliable and must not be trusted. A row is open-ended if valid_to IS NULL or valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' (two conventions coexist). The current version of a customer is the open-ended row with the latest valid_from. Customers with no open-ended row (closed accounts) are excluded. Output columns: customer_id (INT64), address (STRING), tier (STRING), valid_from (DATE).

valid_to.description: Version end (exclusive); NULL or 9999-12-31 when open-ended

is_current.description: Legacy flag; known to be stale for some rows

edge_cases: Customer 4 has two rows flagged is_current = TRUE; only the open-ended one is current
Customer 3 has only closed versions and must not appear
Exactly one row per customer in the output
common_failure_modes: FM7: WHERE is_current = TRUE returns two rows for customer 4 without any uniqueness check
FM5: WHERE valid_to IS NULL misses customers using the 9999-12-31 sentinel
FM3: Taking MAX(valid_from) per customer without checking open-endedness resurrects closed customers
